name: Setmore
tagline: The visible appointment scheduling loop is buildable, but a credible replacement needs more than the first screen. Setmore earns its keep through OAuth, calendar reliability, so expect a weekend or multi-day build and a narrower personal scope.
verdictSummary: KINDA: Setmore costs $12/mo ($144/yr). Here is the practical trade-off and what you lose.
